siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Da Vittorio
siblings.summary: Book one of the 10 rooms at La Dimora — Da Vittorio's own Relais & Châteaux hotel — so you can wobble from the tasting menu to bed; if it's full, Joia Hotel is the only true walkable backup (1.4 km / ~19 min), and everything else needs a taxi.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Da Vittorio
siblings.summary: Seven boutique, historic and agriturismo stays within an 8–12 km taxi ride of Da Vittorio in Brusaporto, ranked by character, price and post-dinner logistics.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Da Vittorio
siblings.summary: A 30-km radius from Da Vittorio (Brusaporto) covers Bergamo Città Alta, the Franciacorta cellars, Lake Iseo and Monte Isola, the UNESCO Crespi d'Adda model village and easy Prealp hikes — enough for two full days around a Saturday-night dinner.
